description: Inverse priced INV collateral via a Keep3r v2 TWAP that read SushiSwap reserves on a thin INV-ETH pool. Attacker swapped a large amount into the pool, called update() on the Keep3r oracle (permissionless) to lock the inflated price for ~30 minutes, deposited a small INV position at the inflated valuation, borrowed everything available against it, and let the position liquidate. TWAP-on-thin-pool is a known anti-pattern. vulnerable_contract is the Keep3rV2Oracle deployed by Inverse Finance for the SushiSwap INV-WETH pair (0x328dFd…F821).
